title: PGP-1.03 memev: engine decision recorded, tier docs aligned, README rewritten, reconciliation against the work breakdown
request: Per-pull-request contract for memev, branch docs/engine-decision-tiers-reconcile. Proposed and unsigned; the signer (ASTL workstream) signs after the red-team gate. Repository: memev. Documents only: no src/ change, no change to docs/scope-one/WBS.md, to any SO-1.x contract, signature or red-team record. RECONCILIATION.md refers to docs/scope-one/WBS.md and to SO-1.02 (reconciliation) and does not restate them. Programme tasks covered: WP16-03 (memev side), WP15-02 (memev side), WP17-05. Owner decisions of 31 Oct 2026 apply: crdt-merge stays in its own repository (BSL 1.1 with its PATENTS file) and is reached only across the call-out boundary, never vendored, so inclusion cannot relicense it; tiers are the free core, Personal at $12/month or $120/year for up to 3 computers, and contact us above that, with no Federated tier and no separate Personal trial; federation is planned, not available. Depends on contracts: SO-1.02.
